lines.text: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Jesus and questioned Him.
They said Moses declared a man's brother is to marry his widow, and told of seven brothers, the first dying childless.
The same happened to the brothers down to the seventh, and they asked whose wife the woman would be in the resurrection.
Jesus said they were mistaken, and that in the resurrection people will be like the prophets in heaven.
Jesus quoted God as the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of the living, and the crowds were offended.
